task.description: Implement ADP-01 end-to-end per the design in src/design/adp-01-tenant-column-event-store.md. Add additive tenant_id support to event store schema and persistence/query paths while preserving default-tenant backward compatibility. Apply required migration changes and indexes, update event append/read APIs and call sites for tenant-scoped behavior, and ensure deterministic handling when tenant context is absent according to design. Include regression coverage that validates existing Stage 1-6 default tenant behavior remains intact and tenant-scoped reads/writes behave correctly. Run full required validations: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and mandatory error-set validation command from the backend guide. Ensure no SQL string interpolation and no transition-engine purity violations.
acceptance_criteria: ADP-01 behavior implemented according to design with additive schema and query semantics
Default-tenant backward compatibility preserved for existing flows
Required migration applies successfully via zig build migrate
zig build and zig build test pass with no error-set propagation issues
Artifacts include implementation files, migration file(s), and test updates

result.summary: Implemented ADP-01 tenant-aware event store behavior end-to-end with additive schema updates, default-tenant compatibility, tenant-scoped query filtering, and integration regression coverage.
